notes: Owner: WP5 (BaseLayout reads it, perimeter.gd reads the kits). A kit is what a slot of the base's perimeter is built with. Its catalogue entry in the layout's `buildings` has the id "kit_<kit>" and `slot_kit` = the kit id; a slot's `kits` lists kit ids, its Build plot's `kits` lists the building ids. hp is the section's hit points (for door_plank, `bonus` true: hit points ADDED to the barred door). scrap and work (builder-hours) are the cost. effects are the building effects the colony reads through build.bonus/factor (tower: reach_bonus, reach_radius; floodlight: night_reach_mult). `stand` is how far outside the fence's outer face the dead stand to claw it. Starting numbers (WP8 tunes them in one_house_tuning.json).

fence.name: Fence section
fence.blurb: Cheap and weak: planks, wire and posts. The dead tear it down in a few minutes.

fence_strong.name: Reinforced fence
fence_strong.blurb: Doubled planks and sheet metal. More than twice the hit points of a plain section.

gate.name: Gate
gate.blurb: A gate on the front. People pass whole; shut, it is a wall, and left open it lets the dead in.

door_plank.name: Planked door
door_plank.blurb: Planks across the barred door: it holds much longer.

tower.name: Small tower
tower.blurb: A lookout and a firing platform: shooters near it reach three tiles further.

floodlight.name: Floodlight
floodlight.blurb: A lamp on a pole and a generator: the guns reach a little further by night and a blackout costs no aim.
